title: The Moment He Knew He Messed Up
description:
Submit a tip! Tips@Midwest-Safety.com

Please consider JOINING for $1 a month. It *really* helps us do original reporting like this. 

CONTACT US:
Complaints? Video submissions? Sponsorships? Collabs? Business inquires? 
Email our board at mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com. 

BE NICE:
The individuals presented in these videos may be suffering from the effects of alcohol, drug abuse, a mental health disorder or simply having a bad day. The videos should NOT be presumed to be representative of their general behavior. Everyone deserves to be treated with respect. 

RIGHT TO BE FORGOTTEN:
Midwest Safety practices the "Right to be Forgotten." If you were the suspect in a lower-level offense, you may email our board to request removal. 
Email: mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com

The shots missed one victim, but hit the other two occupants. One of them survived but was seriously injured. However, the other later died of his injuries. Both suspects were charged with one count of homicide, one count of armed robbery, two counts of assault with intent to murder, one count of carjacking, and four counts of felony weapons offenses. While Ronnie has not yet been sentenced, on December 6, 2024, Stephen pleaded guilty to all nine counts. his sentencing, the murder victim's parents delivered emotional statements, but Stephen showed no remorse as he lashed out at the parents with a vulgar rant. For all nine counts against him, Stephen was sentenced to 40 years in prison.
